resources.string: Download the model to classify SMS on this device.
This device cannot run the on-device model (arm64 required).

Gemma models on Hugging Face are gated. Create a token with Read access, accept the license on the model page, then paste the token here. Qwen models do not need a token.

The token stays on this phone and is only used to download the model.

Classify incoming SMS on this device with a local model. No text leaves the phone.

Add categories with a short description, then set Allow or Block for each category. The model replies with one category name.
The first <title>{}</title> is replaced with the category list (name and description). The second <title>{}</title> is replaced with the SMS body, each line prefixed with <title>></title>.

Pick an on-device LiteRT-LM .litertlm model under 2GB. Default is Gemma-3 1B INT4, 2k (557MB). Smaller models are faster; larger models may classify more accurately.

Download is required once per model. Gemma files on Hugging Face are gated: accept the license and add a Read token. Qwen files are not gated. Classification does not use the internet.
Short meaning of this category, shown to the model in the prompt. You can include a sample SMS, for example: <title>only a passcode of digits. e.g. "123456 is your verification code"</title>.
